title: Quiet Caption Over The Lake
tests: Tests exact caption rendering, readable placement, and preservation of the supplied photograph.

faults.what: An unrequested dark translucent rectangle behind the caption obscures part of the lake reflection and makes the overlay heavier than simple white lettering.

judge.summary: The exact caption is clearly displayed near the bottom of the fully preserved photo, though an unnecessary dark backing box detracts from the clean treatment.

must_haves.item: The caption reads exactly 'A little room to breathe', without quotation marks.
must_haves.why: The wording and capitalization are exact, with no quotation marks.

must_haves.item: The caption is white, readable, and placed near the bottom with no clipped letters.
must_haves.why: The white lettering is clearly legible, positioned near the bottom, and fully contained within the image.

must_haves.item: The supplied mountain lake, pine trees, and sky remain recognizable and retain the original full framing.
must_haves.why: The full wide composition and original scene remain intact with no visible cropping.

must_haves.item: The caption appears as a graphic overlay, not as a physical object in the scene.
must_haves.why: The text and its translucent backing are plainly a flat graphic overlay.
